newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside half year sales A$447.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside half year sales A$447.6 mln.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday its sales revenue for the first half to June 30 rose to A$447.6 million from A$364.5 million a year earlier.

Its quarterly report showed much of the rise was due to a jump in liquids sales in the first quarter, although second quarter revenue was up at A$223.1 million from A$208.9 million for the same period last year.
The second quarter rise was due to a lift in production and sales of condensate to A$69.1 million from A$50.5 million.
Domestic and liquified natural gas (LNG) sales eased to A$117.3 million from A$118.8 million, while crude oil sales fell to A$31.3 million from A$35.6 million.
Revenue from liquified petroleum gas was at A$5.4 million, against A$4.0 million.
Capital expenditure, including evalation and development expenditure, rose to A$3.2 million for the quarter from A$10.0 million a year earlier.
Exploration expenditure rose to A$15.8 million from A$7.5 million.
Woodside has a 50 percent stake in the domestic gas phase of the North-West shalf project offshore Western Australia and a one-sixth stake in the LNG and liquids phase.
